violations.affected_code:
LongPressDraggable<String>(
  data: task,
  ...
  child: Card(
    child: ListTile(title: Text(task)),
  ),
)
violations.explanation: The only way to move a task to 'Done' is a long-press-and-drag gesture onto the DragTarget. Screen reader, switch access and keyboard users cannot reliably perform drag-and-drop, and no alternative such as a button, a checkbox or a custom semantics action (e.g. Semantics(customSemanticsActions: {'Mark as done': ...})) is provided to call _markDone.

violations.type: Missing semantic action/hint for custom interactive control
violations.explanation: The draggable task cards are exposed only as static text. The ListTile has no onTap, and LongPressDraggable does not add a semantic action or hint saying the item can be moved. Assistive technology users get no indication that the item is interactive or how to complete it.

violations.affected_code:
for (final task in _done)
  Card(child: ListTile(title: Text(task))),
violations.explanation: Completion status is conveyed only by which visual column the task sits in. Tasks expose no completed/checked state, and moving a task triggers no announcement. Screen reader users therefore get no feedback when the state changes.
